DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-METAMAGIC.title: Metamagic
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-METAMAGIC.description:
Your current Metamagic.
Generate [gold]Heightened Spell[/gold] or [gold]Quickened Spell[/gold] with leftover Metamagic.
Add a random with less than 4, create both with 4 leftover metamagic next turn.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-POTENCY.title: Ability Potency
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-POTENCY.description:
Your current Ability Potency.
Affects [color=#42edce]Potent[/color] Cards
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-SPELLS.title: Spells and Spellslots
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-SPELLS.description:
The Spell level of cards is depicted by the Roman Numerals.
When there is a spellslot available for said level, spell cards gain -1 cost and consume said spell slot when played.
Playing a spell without an available spellslot will generate an Arcane Exhaustion, lower Ability Potency.
